facts.fact: OpenRouter's Discover page says it lists 627 models in total.
The page states that Anthropic's model edges Google's by 5 points on the Artificial Analysis intelligence index (third-party benchmark).
facts.quote: Anthropic edges Google by 5 points on the Artificial Analysis intelligence index.

facts.fact: On the Artificial Analysis intelligence index (0–100), the page lists Claude Fable 5.2 (Anthropic) at 65.
On the Artificial Analysis intelligence index (0–100), the page lists Gemini 4 Carbon (Google) at 60.
On the Artificial Analysis intelligence index (0–100), the page lists GPT-6 Astra (OpenAI) at 57.
On the Artificial Analysis intelligence index (0–100), the page lists Grok 4.7 (SpaceXAI) at 36.
The page lists Kimi K3.1 Pro with an intelligence score of 47.
The page lists Claude Fable 5.1 with a coding index score of 82.
The page lists GLM 5.3 Flash at a price of $0.04 per million tokens.
Per the page, a response from OpenRouter's Auto Router (Beta) is priced at the same rate as the model it routed to.
facts.quote: Your response will be priced at the same rate as the routed model.

facts.fact: Per the page, a request through the Fusion router is priced as the sum of the underlying completions for every panel member plus the judge call, rather than as a single model.
facts.quote: your request is priced as the sum of those underlying completions rather than a single model
